checks.evidence_scope: source_sha256 binds both final checkout and source_commit; following commit changes evidence JSON only.

limits: Bounded control/content wire experiments only; no encrypted SQLite outbox, relay or application integration.
Authority, writer registrations and keys remain in test memory; no durable fork evidence, key storage, enrollment, admin transfer, recovery, nonempty historical frontiers or receive chain.
Structural golden keys and zero signatures are placeholders; actual random-key cryptographic tests use the selected provider on both sides.
Independent CBOR/hash/HKDF/AES fixtures do not establish exact-suite hybrid HPKE or signature interoperability, or complete protocol security.
First data update only; no snapshot authority, historical continuation, task-domain validation or production hostile-import work/memory bound.
No aarch64 run, fuzz campaign, production crypto-usage bound, secure erasure guarantee or independent security review.

key_distribution.flow: Independent pinned-root receiver authenticates admin-signed HPKE CEK envelope, admits signed writer-start, verifies/decrypts first data record, and imports the admitted actor Loro update with exact text assertion.
key_distribution.state_scope: Test-only in-memory authority and keys, not connected to SQLite journal or app.
key_distribution.randomness: OS-seeded selected provider RNG for key generation, signatures, CEKs, random record IDs and HPKE; entropy errors propagate.
key_distribution.oracle_scope: Python cbor2/hashlib validates canonical CBOR, fingerprints, SHA-384 and HPKE info/AAD transcripts; patterned public keys and zero signatures are structurally valid placeholders only.
key_distribution.writer_scope: One active lineage per device/document; old heads retired, exact retries do not reactivate, valid competing roots/successors freeze that lineage with both signed byte strings retained in memory.
